item.title: 【Cinema Center】SERIES - ‎Shows Collection (1080p H.264 WEB-DL) No Filehost | Support Stremio/Nuvio addon
item.description:
‎This would be my last post on the cinema center.
‎Don't know since when Terabox has been slower the download speed from the PC app itself and the web version. I'm done with that .

‎Yesterday I found out the existence of TeleStremio app. That allows me to use my telegram as addon on Streamio/Nuvio. Streaming directly without need to download any files. I'm 2 months late.
"Language is not supposed to be barrier for knowledge, use google translate or a.i if my instructions aren't clear."

Requirements :
- Android phone
- TeleStremio apk => Download here => https://github.com/weebzone/Telegram-Stremio/releases/tag/v1.0.7
- API_ID / API_HASH => visit my.telegram.org -> Login → API development tools → create an app.
API_ID & API_HASH is used as username/password to login to TeleStremio app...use it carefully.

Can be deployed for "multiple users" on:
Heroku
VPS (recommended)
Koyeb / Render / orkestr (free)
Cloudflare streaming (optional)
Check the full Guide here : https://github.com/weebzone/Telegram-Stremio




The tutorial videos for personal use on phone are below
1) Setting Up TeleStremio App

Install and Login to TeleStremio app on your phone
1️⃣ Create a public channel
2️⃣ Copy the channel link ▶️ Click Add on "Channels" Section
3️⃣ Forward the Shows/ Episodes you'd like to watch
4️⃣ Click Scan/ Rescan from scratch
5️⃣ If it works, on Library you can see the poster for the shows is available
6️⃣ On "Home" Section, Click on the "Addon server Running" and Turn it on
7️⃣ Copy the manifest.json link

2) Setting Up Stremio & Nuvio

8️⃣ Paste the manifest.json link to Stremio/Nuvio addon
9️⃣ Finish
Stream the Shows that available on my group without need to download or even extract them.
